title: PSyGenTAB
summary: PSyGenTAB is a model-agnostic framework for generating privacy-preserving synthetic tabular data via constrained optimization (Augmented Lagrangian Method) applied to REaLTabFormer and CTAB-GAN+ generators. Its evaluation pipeline optionally computes SDMetrics QualityReport/DiagnosticReport scores and SDV's SingleTableMetadata schema as one of several utility/fidelity metrics compared against MostlyAI and privacy-attack evaluations.
